subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should the pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as the public policy notice now that the contribution guide and automation already enforce the 20-PR cap?
rationale: Current code/docs are aligned, but the live pinned/reopened state and needs-product-decision label are explicit admin-policy signals that automation should not override.

options.title: Keep Pinned Notice
options.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the durable public explanation for the hard cap.

options.title: Retire To Docs
options.body: Unpin and close the issue only if maintainers decide CONTRIBUTING.md is now the sole policy source.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned Notice
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open and pinned as the durable public explanation for the hard cap.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman provided the latest explicit rename, pin, and reopen signal for this policy notice.
